licence.scope: Option (2): NASA Images and Media Usage Guidelines, which cover NASA content generally; they are not a statement on the Viking Lander PDS calibration files themselves. The PDS volume SVO cites (https://pdsimage2.wr.usgs.gov/cdroms/Viking_Lander/vl_0001/calib/) is a JavaScript page that gives no text to curl, and pds.nasa.gov / pds-imaging.jpl.nasa.gov showed no data-use statement. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
